verdict.rationale: Zep explicitly generates and incrementally updates natural-language thread summaries (zep-docs-8), retrievable via context blocks that combine summaries, edges, nodes, and episodes for an agent to resume context (zep-docs-10, zep-docs-30), and this is served in under 200ms directly from thread.add_messages() calls (zep-docs-26, zep-docs-34). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of summary quality across long multi-session threads, and no explicit example showing an agent resuming a conversation mid-task using a retrieved summary.
